comparison.objective: Locate a buried corner iron using two measured witness tapes and stand a stake over it; candidate breaks and retrieves insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Geometric localization from two distances and stake placement versus recessed coaxial tool use, bimanual hammering, controlled fracture, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Place and release the stake at the inferred buried point versus fracture four manufactured notches and contain every fragment without damaging retained hardware.
comparison.reason: The record tests triangulation and placement rather than force-controlled assembly finishing. No specs or numeric placement tolerance are supplied.
